prescribedGeometry.description: PV-04: source-declared prescribed display representative. No EOM evolution, balance evaluation, retention, or stability calculation is performed by this record.

platonicVertices.polarityRule: sign of first nonzero Cartesian vertex coordinate

choices: Algebraic vertex coordinates follow the shared-sphere chapter and its balanced-word enumeration instrument, normalized to circumradius 0.5. One representative coloring assigns the sign of the first nonzero Cartesian coordinate; it is balanced and, except for the tetrahedron, opposite at antipodes.

All vertices rotate rigidly about (1,2,4)/sqrt(21) at angular rate pi/2. This generic axis is a display choice; the initial vertex set and every pair distance are preserved. This is one colored moving example, not an exhaustive coloring collection or a balanced motion result. No braid component or neutral binary is assigned from polyhedral appearance.

History spans two source periods with 64 cubic intervals per period. Delay horizon zero denotes display-only coverage, not a supplied causal ledger. The common center is fixed; c_f=1. The schema braid role marks primary assembly members, not an assigned braid identity. Only explicit componentBraids assign composition.
